# Recreation Prompt

Create a mobile-first portrait browser game titled **Throne of Ash & Ice**. Preserve the mechanics of a central-base defense resource game: autonomous orbiting defenders intercept enemies that march inward from the screen edge; tapping the playfield redirects the nearest defender; defeated enemies grant currency; three bottom buttons buy another defender, improve defender speed, and improve damage; pressure escalates over time; base health reaching zero ends the run with restart.

Reinterpret the game as a satirical dynasty strategy drama: the central base is the Iron Seat's legitimacy, defenders are sworn house champions and dragon-riders, enemies are rival claimants and icy apocalypse hosts, projectiles are raven decrees or dragonfire, currency is influence, and failure is a brutal succession collapse. Use procedural Canvas/CSS art with crown, sword, house banners, embers, snow, medieval panels, and mobile-readable HUD controls for portrait aspect ratios.

Original steering prompt: Dynasty strategy drama. A satirical game inspired by Game of Thrones with warring houses, political betrayal, dragons, icy apocalypse tension, brutal succession conflict, medieval grandeur, and high-stakes power games with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Game Truth
- genre: mobile-first canvas strategy-defense / resource management game
- objective: protect a central base while autonomous defenders intercept inbound enemies, earn currency, and buy upgrades
- input model: start/restart buttons, three upgrade buttons, and canvas tap/pointer commands that redirect the nearest active defender
- core loop: enemies spawn from the perimeter and move inward; defenders orbit, engage, shoot, return, and can be commanded; defeated enemies grant currency; currency buys more defenders, speed, and damage; spawn pressure escalates over time
- fail/friction state: central health reaches zero after enemies contact the base, causing game over with final currency total and restart

## Protected Mechanics
- Base health starts at 100, enemy contact damage remains 5 for normal enemies and 20 for heavy enemies, and health <= 0 triggers game over.
- Starting currency remains 200; upgrade costs start at 100/150/200 and grow by the same multipliers.
- Defender speed, damage, range, projectile speed, spawn timing, difficulty growth, tap command search radius, and projectile/enemy hit behavior preserve the old implementation.
- Canvas pointer input stays scoped to the playfield; UI click/tap controls stay native.

## Remix Blueprint
The old orbital defense loop is reinterpreted as **Throne of Ash & Ice**, a satirical succession crisis where the player holds the Iron Seat against rival claimants and an icy apocalypse. Defenders are sworn house champions/dragon-riders, enemies are claimant banners and frozen hosts, currency is influence, upgrades are alliances, ravens, and dragonfire, and the central base is the legitimacy of the throne.
